background_setting: A city street seen from a front-facing dashcam: an asphalt road with painted lane markings and curbs, sidewalks, mid-rise buildings with shop fronts, street trees and lamp posts along both sides, parked cars at the kerb, and traffic lights at the intersections ahead.

lighting.direction: Sunlight from high overhead, slightly behind the camera
lighting.shadows: Crisp, short shadows under cars, trees and buildings
lighting.illumination_effect: Natural, evenly lit scene with realistic contrast and true-to-life colors

aesthetics.composition: Symmetrical dashcam framing with the horizon at the exact vertical center; the road fills the lower half, buildings and sky the upper half; no part of the ego vehicle is visible
aesthetics.color_scheme: Neutral asphalt grey, white and yellow lane paint, green foliage, beige and brick building facades, blue sky

cinematography.framing: Wide shot, camera mounted at the top of the windshield: no hood or dashboard visible, the horizon sits at the vertical center of the frame
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus from the road surface to the distant buildings

context: Dashcam footage from a camera mounted high on the windshield of a car driving along a city street on a sunny day; no hood visible

actions.description: The recording vehicle drives forward along the lane, following the road and passing buildings, trees and parked cars; the road markings and boundaries stay exactly where the control map places them.

temporal_caption: From 0:00 to 0:10 the dashcam shows a car driving steadily along a sunlit city street, lane markings passing beneath, buildings and trees sliding by on both sides.
audio_description: Road noise and a steady engine hum; no speech or music.
